text:
Sana Iqbal: Team 1: prep check for Marketplace + Partner Summit next Tue. Need final owners: speaker MC, demo VM handoff, who signs customs, swag routing, and VIP meet-and-greet schedule.
Marco Ruiz: Ill MC and own the speaker cadence. Plan: 4 lightning talks (7m) then 2 deep-dive demos (15m). Will collect 1-slide bio + headshot.
Elena Voss: Partner infra: asking partners to provide Docker image or VM export. Prefer we stage images in our private registry 48h prior. Ill run compatibility checks.
Lia Gomez: Swag ops: propose 45 attendee bundles + 10 VIP bundles (partner co-branded pin, cable, 1-pager). Recommend we use local courier for EU to avoid brokerage delays. Will draft manifest.
Derek White: AV & recording: need attendee-facing stream + partner raw feed. Ill do attendee stream; Elena can capture raw if shes staging. Also request discrete partner-only S3 bucket with limited access.
Sana Iqbal: Legal question: are co-branded pins allowed for EU giveaways? Copying legal-bot.
legal-bot: EU giveaway check required 1: require local sweepstakes compliance for physical prizes. Please provide giveaway method + terms by Fri.
Marco Ruiz: For VIP meet-and-greet, propose 10-min slots post-show for 6 VIPs. Lia can assemble VIP packs to hand over there.
Lia Gomez: Will include a handoff checklist inside VIP packs: contact, return label, loaner instructions. Also adding a QR card to the repo with sample prompts.
Elena Voss: Staging plan: partners push images to registry by Mon 18:00 PT. Ill run a dry-run of demo start-up (cold boot + KV warm) Tue 08:00 PT. If live demo fails, we cut to pre-recorded overlay.
Derek White: Bring 1 spare HDMI encoder, 2 USB-C adapters, and a battery hotspot. Also confirm venue allows wired ethernet for demo rigs; ops-bot can validate.
ops-bot: Venue networking check scheduled for 2026-08-01 09:30 PT. Automated DM to tech leads 24h before.
Sana Iqbal: Run-of-show v1 below. Please flag asap.
Sana Iqbal: ```
12:00 Load-in + AV check
12:30 Welcome + 3m intros
12:35 Lightning talks (4 x 7m)
13:03 Break + swag table opens
13:20 Deep-dive demos (2 x 15m)
13:50 VIP meet + demo Q&A (10m slots)
14:20 Closing + post-event survey
```
Marco Ruiz: Suggest we swap deep-dive order: put partner SI first to show integrator flow, then hardware partner. That helps the narrative into Marketplace listing.
Elena Voss: Good call. Also adding a perf snapshot to the slide deck for each demo (latency & cost). Marco, can you reserve 2 slides per demo for metrics?
Lia Gomez: Shipping decision: EU partners ship direct; NA & APAC to Redwood HQ. Lia will print return labels and coordinate courier pick-up.
legal-bot: Note for customs: include HS codes and invoice values. If partners want Redwood to declare value, we need written authorization per partner.
Sana Iqbal: Action items: Marco 1: speaker deck + bios by Mon. Elena 1: images in registry by Mon + dry-run Tue AM. Lia 1: manifest + courier picks by Mon EOD. Derek: AV spares + recording plan by Tue. Legal: give quick compliance note on giveaways by Fri.
Marco Ruiz: Ill post the slide folder in 30m. Please upload headshots there. :thumbsup:
Lia Gomez: Will post shipping manifest and tracking links in #logistics when labels print.
Sana Iqbal: Thanks all 1: tight timeline but doable. Lets close items by Mon EOD so dry-run is low-stress. :rocket:
